name: Budislav (Svitavy District, Czechia)
description: Green field with a diagonal band of yellow, black and yellow from the lower hoist to the upper fly, and a yellow lion rampant with red tongue and claws in the upper fly.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 27 January 1997 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
